author: DarloBigwang
quote: 7 hours into gameplay and "missions". Everything is chores. Jason the man does everything for Lucia. Lucia does nothing but blame others and tries to find places to put accountability. The whole story to a women girl bossing a man to the point she gets him murdered or locked up for the crimes SHE commited. Ending is terrible. The kid loses regardless of how you play. the "good" ending is Lucia taking your child while you rot in prison and 2 girl boss kick ass women raise the kid. Red dead honor system doesnt work with gta. Driving is mid at best. Radio is cool. No 1st person but there is a glitch which proves it was just removed and not " couldnt be added in time"
